2007 Nissan Altima Engine Parts

Catalog updated · Sep 2026·768 Parts·71 Part types·73 Brands·Covers 3 engine options·Change vehicle

As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

768 engine parts from 73 brands fit the 2007 Nissan Altima across the 2.5L L4, 2.5L L4 hybrid and 3.5L V6. 53 fit every engine; 715 are engine-specific — match your engine first. 2007 Nissan Altima oil notes list SAE 0W-20, SAE 0W-30, SAE 5W-20, SAE 5W-30, SAE 10W-30 and SAE 10W-40.

Engine parts for the 2007 Nissan Altima are led by oil, variable valve timing (vvt) solenoid / actuator, timing chain & component kit and crankshaft seal. Brands include MAHLE / Clevite, Enginetech and Melling.

Crankshaft Seal

This section lists the front and rear seals that keep oil in at the crankshaft. Typical signs include a wet housing, a drip after sitting, or fluid flung off a rotating shaft. Fix the surface the seal rides on. A new seal on a grooved shaft will leak again.

Variable Valve Timing (VVT) Solenoid Gasket / Seal

This section lists the seals at the Variable Valve Timing (VVT) Solenoid Gasket. Typical signs include a wet housing, a drip after sitting, or fluid flung off a rotating shaft. Fix the surface the seal rides on. A new seal on a grooved shaft will leak again.

How to read these tables

Each table row is one part for this vehicle. Use the columns and badges below so you order the right number — not a look-alike for another engine, market, or grade.

Market badges (US, CA, MX)

The Markets column shows where that part’s fitment was published — the country where the vehicle was first sold, not where the part was manufactured.

  • 🇺🇸 US United States — vehicles first sold in the United States.
  • 🇨🇦 CA Canada — vehicles first sold in Canada.
  • 🇲🇽 MX Mexico — vehicles first sold in Mexico.

A row can show more than one badge when the same part number is listed for multiple markets. If only one badge appears, that is all the source catalog published for that number — still confirm notes and your vehicle’s market if you are unsure.

Popular badge

Popular marks parts the catalog flags as commonly applied to this vehicle. It is a demand signal, not a quality or safety rating.

Economy, Standard, Premium, and similar headers

When a part type splits into groups like Economy or Standard Replacement, those are catalog sales grades for how the part is sold — not different vehicles. Pick the grade that matches how you drive; the notes column still carries position and fit details.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many engine parts fit the 2007 Nissan Altima?

768 engine parts fit the 2007 Nissan Altima across 3 engines on AutoFactsDB.com.

Do engine parts differ between the 2007 Nissan Altima engines?

Some do. For the 2007 Nissan Altima, 53 parts fit every engine (2.5L L4, 2.5L L4 hybrid and 3.5L V6) and 715 parts are engine-specific. Match your engine first.

What do the US, CA and MX badges mean on 2007 Nissan Altima parts?

They mark the country where the vehicle was first sold — United States, Canada or Mexico — not where the part was made. A row can show more than one badge when the same part number is published for multiple markets.

Which brands supply engine parts for the 2007 Nissan Altima?

MAHLE / Clevite, Enginetech and Melling supply engine parts for the 2007 Nissan Altima, among 73 brands listed.

What engine types are listed for the 2007 Nissan Altima?

The largest engine types for the 2007 Nissan Altima are oil, variable valve timing (vvt) solenoid / actuator and timing chain & component kit.
